name: alps
description: Clarify work through Process Descriptions and design the agents, tools, information resources, and environments that realize it.

interface.shortDescription: Design work and the systems that realize it
interface.longDescription: ALPS helps clarify the purpose, observable success conditions, and necessary boundaries of work, and design the agents, tools, information resources, and environments that realize it. Create, revise, or review Process Descriptions and supporting configurations. Allocate judgment and processing, implement needed capabilities within the request, and assess both tool behavior and effectiveness through representative work.
capabilities: Clarify purpose, Outcomes, and work boundaries
Design agent and tool responsibilities and interfaces
Evaluate descriptions, tools, and work-system effectiveness
defaultPrompt: Use design-process-description to clarify this work and its observable success conditions.
Use design-agent-work-system to design and verify the capabilities and interfaces that realize this work.
Review this work description and supporting configuration; report findings without changing them.
